analysis_status: response-source reconstruction from public raw dated records; no ecological predictor effects inspected to define periods
purpose: Replace dependence on unavailable RData bytes for Stage-1 response reconstruction by applying the subseason boundaries stated in the Dryad methods to public raw visit dates.

subseason_rule.early: date < November 1 of the declared study year
subseason_rule.late: date > November 30 of the declared study year, including January observations assigned to the preceding study year
subseason_rule.provenance: Dryad dataset methods state that visits were pooled into three approximately equal subseasons: before November 1st, after November 30th, and in between.

analysis_subset.reason: freeze the same trait-available subset used by the annual Stage-1 fallback before constructing the response surface

interaction_weight: sum no.fl.visit over all sites and raw observation rows within study year x subseason x plant x pollinator

undated_policy.rule: positive visit rows without a date are not assigned to a subseason
required_report: annual links represented only by undated rows
undated_policy.promotion_rule: the reconstructed 12-transition surface may be used as the preferred raw-record Stage-1 response if every transition remains estimable and the undated-row limitation is explicit; analyses sensitive to 2011 must retain a dated-complete sensitivity excluding 2011

presence_semantics: observed-positive-link presence unless an independent subseason presence surface is supplied; therefore response remains detection-sensitive
claim_ceiling: This reconstructs the documented temporal response grain from public raw records. It does not by itself establish true species presence, sampling-effort-corrected rewiring, ecological filtering, decision equivalence, or routeability.
